*** SPRINT 73 / V0.29.28 -- 3 of 4 DONE (US-549 I-043, US-550 I-044, US-543 A-4 parity guard). ONE LEFT: US-545 (A-18 BT bond self-heal, M, 4 ACs incl. 3 Atlas refinements). Not blocked -- pick it up. ***

*** THE LESSON I MOST WANT YOU TO HAVE, AND IT IS AIMED SQUARELY AT US-545: A FORCED-OVERRIDE / MOCK-DRIVEN TEST PROVES THE MOCK WORKS AND SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE PATH THAT RUNS ON THE PI. *** US-550's mutation C (`id -u ... || echo 0`, the exact silent fallback the story forbade) stayed GREEN because my fail-loud test short-circuited at the override branch and never ran the real probe. US-545 is ALL mock-driven (bluetoothctl, systemctl, the BT stack) -- every single assertion there is exposed to this. For each test ask: does anything exercise the real invocation, or only my fake? Prefer a test that unsets the override and lets the genuine call genuinely fail.

US-543 AS BUILT: scripts/audit_sync_contract_parity.py (pure check functions + CLI, audit_address_mirrors pattern) + tests/lint/test_pi_server_contract_parity.py (71 tests). Table set = sync_log.PK_COLUMN UNION snapshot_registry.SNAPSHOT_SYNC, computed per call = complete-by-construction. Pi side loads the APPLIED schema by running a real ObdDatabase.initialize() into a temp SQLite file; server applied side rides the US-464/470 MariaDB harness and skips honestly (no Docker on this box).

*** THE GUARD FOUND 3 REAL DIVERGENCES ON ITS FIRST RUN, AND CLASSIFYING THEM MATTERED MORE THAN FIXING THEM. *** 1 was a genuine defect (drive_summary's PK rename shipped in US-206 but was never declared in schema_diff.PI_PK_RENAMED_TO_ID -- the exact 'new synced table without its mapping' case). 2 were MY model being incomplete: dtc_freeze_frame does not use the generic bind path, it has a bespoke cross-tier resolver (US-369) that renames vehicle_info_vin -> vehicle_info_id and drops data_source. If I had widened the exemption until the noise stopped, the real one would have been buried with them. A first-run guard that comes up RED needs every finding classified real-defect vs incomplete-model BEFORE any fix.

DELIBERATE AC DEVIATION, FLAGGED NOT NARROWED -- PM/Atlas own it: offices/pm/inbox/2026-08-10-from-ralph-us543-data-quality-parity-needs-atlas-ruling.md. AC said data_source AND data_quality set-equality both ways; data_source is exactly that, but data_quality is NOT a shared contract (Pi={full,clock_unsynced}, wire-STRIPPED; server={full,attribution_anomaly,foreign_vehicle,sparse,below_threshold,unmappable_legacy}; server power_log/startup_log have no such column). So the check is CONDITIONAL on the strip and flips to full set-equality the day it is removed. Mutating the strip away took it 5 RED naming both directions -- teeth proven, because a conditional check nobody has watched fire is just a disabled check.

5 MUTATIONS, reverted BY HAND (git checkout is outside the allow-list), byte-exact per `git diff --numstat`: src/pi/data/sync_log.py shows NO diff at all; scripts/schema_diff.py reads +14/-0 (pure addition). Mutation C (skip initialize() in the Pi loader) went 8 RED including the populated-ColumnSpec positive control -- an empty/degenerate schema load must never pass vacuously, and that is the one failure mode a parity guard dies of quietly.

*** I WALKED INTO THE SUBSTRING TRAP AGAIN -- THIRD SPRINT RUNNING, SAME LESSON. *** My design guard asserted `'create_all' not in source` and it FAILED, because the audit module documents the create_all trap in its own header. US-522's was a false negative, US-550's and this one are false positives. If a guard asserts the ABSENCE of a token that the correct file may legitimately discuss, you MUST tokenize -- I used an `ast` walk over Name/Attribute/alias nodes with a positive control (a planted call IS found) and a negative one (the same text in a comment is NOT).

FILED NOT ABSORBED: TD-079 -- schema_diff.loadPiSchema's hand-listed DDL registry cannot see dtc_freeze_frame (it arrives via ensureDtcFreezeFrameTable), so the TD-039 drift gate has been reporting 'shared tables clean' over a synced table it never loads. My guard covers it; schema_diff still does not.

GATE: tests/lint/ (71 new + A-15 mirror) + 5 sharing suites (test_schema_diff, test_sync_log_pk_variants, test_data_source_foreign_marker, test_data_source_applied_schema_accepts_foreign, test_sync_client) -- ALL PASSED, EXIT 0, green after every revert. ruff clean on 3 touched .py files. My diff touches src/ NOT AT ALL.

ENVIRONMENT (all still true): `make` is NOT on PATH -- exits 127, WHICH READS LIKE A PASS; use `python -m ruff check <file>`. pytest config SUPPRESSES the `N passed` line -- trust the exit code, grepping for 'passed' returns nothing on a clean run. Glob over the repo root TIMES OUT (SMB share); `git ls-files | grep` is instant. THE GREP TOOL CANNOT SEE specs/UI/dist/ (gitignored-but-tracked, ripgrep honours .gitignore) -- use `git grep`. A full targeted pytest run WILL exceed the 120s Bash timeout and get backgrounded (a backgrounded result is LOST per TD-059) -- split it into synchronous batches.

STILL OWED, Pi-side (batch on the next deploy+boot): US-550 -- `systemctl show splash-boot.service -p Environment -p User` must read /run/user/1000 NOT /run/user/0, and the journal clean of dconf/'Could not parse server address'; ASSERT AGAINST `systemctl show`, NOT the unit text. US-549 -- `journalctl -u splash-grace.service | grep '[shutdown-splash] terminal'` on the next clean shutdown. US-543 -- PM call on what 'standing CI' means beyond a pytest file (pre-commit hook? deploy gate invoking the CLI?), plus the testcontainers+Docker enablement US-464 already owes so the A2 applied-server layer stops skipping. Prior sprint's F-126 debts + the I-us536 autoRotateS:0 resolver defect unchanged (offices/ralph/archive/ + PM issues folder).
